project.name: Billing
project.summary: Billing sends a small studio's invoices and records what was paid. It replaces a spreadsheet and a folder of PDFs.

nouns.name: customer
nouns.purpose: Who is billed: identity, contact and billing address.

nouns.name: invoice
nouns.purpose: What a customer owes, its lines, and whether it was sent, paid or voided.

nouns.name: payment
nouns.purpose: Money received against an invoice, as the processor reported it.

flows.name: month_end
flows.purpose: Send every unsent invoice for the closing month, once.

adapters.name: email
adapters.purpose: Sends one message to one address.

adapters.name: drafting
adapters.purpose: Drafts a payment reminder in the studio's voice.

rejected: - A single `billing` noun holding customers, invoices and payments: every change would touch everything.
- Stripe as a noun: it is an outside service, so it is an adapter when it arrives.
decisions.reopens: Payments start arriving from more than one processor, or invoices need approval before sending.

owner.name: Ada
owner.writing:
- Terse and technical.
- Consequence first; no hedging.

harness.what_it_is: Billing sends a small studio's invoices and records what was paid. It replaces a spreadsheet and a folder of PDFs.
harness.who_uses_it: The studio's operator, at month end, with the client list open, sending invoices and checking who has paid.
harness.today_instead: The operator copies last month's spreadsheet, edits each row, exports PDFs and emails them one by one, about three hours a month.
harness.failure_in_a_year: The operator is back in the spreadsheet because Billing sent an invoice twice and nobody trusted it again.
harness.goals:
- Every invoice for the month goes out once, to the right address.
- What each customer owes is visible in one place.
harness.not_this:
- Not accounting: it never books revenue or tax.
- Not a payment processor: it records what the processor reports.
harness.floors:
- Money is integer cents, never floating point.
- No invoice is sent twice: sending is idempotent by invoice key.
harness.first_stage_goal: The operator creates a customer and sees it on every way in.
harness.first_gate_demo: The operator creates a customer from the command line and sees the same customer from the web page and from an agent's tool call. Break it: create a valid customer beside one with an empty email and confirm only the broken one is refused, naming the field.
harness.first_gate_tried_to_break: an empty email; a duplicate key; a name with only spaces; the same create sent twice; a valid customer beside a broken one.
harness.first_gate_acceptance: The operator creates a customer on the command line and can say: I see the same customer everywhere, and a broken one was refused by name.
harness.later_gates:
Later: one line each, until intake writes them out in full.

- send-an-invoice: the operator sends one invoice and the customer receives it once.
- record-a-payment: a payment the processor reports shows against its invoice.
harness.interview_transcript:
**Q: Who uses it, and when?**
Options: the studio operator at month end (recommended); a bookkeeper.
Answer: "The operator, at month end."
